### Focus Determines Direction
Author: Rachel Olsen
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/focus-determines-direction-encouragement-for-today-jan-8-2013.html
Passage: Hebrews 12:2
Points:
- What we fix our attention on determines the direction our life takes, much like race car drivers who steer toward where they look.
- Staring at personal weaknesses, failures, or life's problems leads to spiritual crashes and defeat.
- Looking to Jesus shifts our perspective away from self-reliance and immediate struggles.
- Spiritual growth occurs when we trust Christ, the author and perfecter of faith, to produce lasting change.

### Run With Endurance
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/run-endurance
Passage: Hebrews 12:1
Points:
- The life of faith is like a marathon footrace requiring sustained endurance rather than quick bursts of effort.
- Old covenant saints form a cloud of witnesses whose faithful perseverance inspires believers to press forward.
- Clinging sins act like heavy garments that weigh runners down and must be cast aside.
- God sustains believers in the race and provides the community of the church as an ongoing source of encouragement.
